name: 8gnc
description: Diagnose what is blocking brand growth, separate evidence from assumption, and route the work into the smallest useful 8gnc method.

interface.shortDescription: Find the constraint before you buy the tactic.
interface.longDescription: Bring an unclear offer, a stalled brand, weak conversion, invisible search presence, or a sales motion that is not moving. 8gnc names the primary constraint, separates evidence from inference, routes the work into the smallest useful method, and can present the result as a focused inline Working Diagnosis.
defaultPrompt: Use 8gnc to diagnose what is actually blocking my brand before recommending a tactic.
Use 8gnc to pressure-test our positioning against the market and show the white space.
Use 8gnc to turn this product strategy into a decision-ready plan with risks and next steps.
